Small fill vs target signals tight funding conditions and investor caution.
Large shortfall may pressure future issuance or policy settings.
High clearing yields reflect elevated risk and inflation expectations.
Demand sought higher yields than accepted, implying tighter pricing ahead.
Wide bid tail underscores uncertainty and term-risk premium.
